Chapter 6299: Two Li Qiye

Chapter 6299: Two Li Qiye

Li Qiye added a bit of strength to his push and the tablet rotated again.

The woman stood speechless - this was the supreme tablet of their sect, their ultimate legacy. Alas, he was moving it effortlessly like a dice.

“Buzz.” The scripture was tossed out again and the eighty-one characters surrounded her.

Of course, they didn’t harm her and only took her to a different dao world. She looked around and saw laws, runes, and mysteries everywhere. The dao was plentiful and pure beyond anything she had seen.

It didn’t matter how strong she was, this world could give her an endless source of power. More shockingly, the runes from the scripture circled her and harmonized with her grand dao.

Her cultivation originated from the scripture so she felt a sense of ascension, gaining several levels and becoming as strong as her ancestor, Jiang Ba.

“This is…” She became frightened instead of ecstatic at her newfound power.

“It is a dao world.” Li Qiye smiled: “If you want to try, I will let you taste a power beyond your cultivation, we will see how it fares against the power of the dao heart.”

He stood before her like a mortal, devoid of any dao power.

“I will not hold back.” She took a deep breath and removed fear.

“Boom!” She clenched her fist and felt the powers of this world surging toward her.

She was plenty strong before but now, this power was unprecedented. She thought she was the lord, none could escape her grasp.

The strongest merit laws and techniques were still under her jurisdiction. She believed she was only one step away from becoming a supreme overlord.

She feared nothing while wielding this power; no opponent existed that her punch couldn’t solve.

“Let me hang myself first so that you don’t accuse me of using dao power.” Li Qiye smiled and raised both hands, gradually floating into the air.

The rising Li Qiye seemed frozen, like a coat hanging on the wall. Another him remained standing on the ground.

She gasped and staggered backward upon seeing the two versions. Although the upper version looked inactive, he looked like the source of everything.

There was no sign of life but she feared him more than anything else due to his primordial presence. He wielded more power than any world or cultivators.

She saw many powerful figures before but none compared to this version.

Meanwhile, the one on the bottom appeared ordinary just like a mortal. The stark contrast between the two versions was impossible to accept.

“Which one are you…” She asked.

The obvious choice was the one floating in the air - a being superior to all things. The one below should only be an illusion.

“Both are me.” Li Qiye said flatly.

“A dao avatar?” She asked while staring at the mortal Li Qiye.

“No.” Li Qiye shook his head: “One has the grand dao while the other only the dao heart. Since you couldn’t be convinced with words, I will use this version without any dao power to suppress you.”

She froze momentarily due to the unprecedented underestimation of her power. He made it sound so easy.

“Which one do you like more?” She couldn’t help but ask.

She felt that the dao heart Li Qiye didn’t belong to this world, only wanting to leave.

“One and the same, no preference.” Li Qiye smiled.

She couldn’t respond because this wasn’t a case of the true self versus a dao avatar. Were they both him?

“Time to use your strongest technique, let’s see how long you can last.” Li Qiye said.
